_comment: Canonical, FROZEN QA test strings. Do not change a value once committed — the baseline.json digests and every downstream comparison depend on these exact bytes. Each `value` is interpreted as UTF-8. Strings 1-3 deliberately share the same letters (lowercase / uppercased / random-case) so case-sensitivity is provable.

strings.category: alpha, mixed-case (= alpha-lower letters, random case)
alphanumeric + extended symbols (full ASCII keyboard punctuation)
